criteria.note: `isSelected` is now `derive(function() return props.Selected() == props.BlockType.Name end)`, and the UIStroke `Color` and `Thickness` are functions that read `isSelected()`, so the outline follows the selection.
`show(isHovered, function() return infoCard({...}) end)` builds the card in a stable scope instead of inside a children binding.
`cleanup(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan))` ties the connection to the picker's scope, so handlers don't pile up and Q and E stop working outside build mode.
`pickerGui` calls `cleanup(gui)` and is mounted with `mount(pickerGui, playerGui)`, with an `if destroyPicker then return end` guard, so destroying the mount removes the ScreenGui.
`WaitForChild("PlayerGui")` now runs at module level outside any scope, and `selectedDisplayName` is a plain function instead of an effect writing a source.
